items.question: What kind of suffering befalls beings confined within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings are placed in womb-diagrams counted by the thousands.
The total count reaches eighty-four thousand such womb-diagrams.
Those beings within them undergo torment.
items.inference: Beings dwelling in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are subject to torment.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
